newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss Christmas tree gets million dollar trim.
newsitem.headline: Swiss Christmas tree gets million dollar trim.

text.p: The wealthy Swiss city of Geneva hopes to get into the Guinness Book of Records with the world's most expensive Christmas tree, decked with diamonds weighing 1,000 carats and jewellery worth millions of dollars.

Swiss jewellery maker Piaget said it would set up the tree on Thursday in a central square and decorate it with diamonds worth 10 million Swiss Francs (more than $8 million) and jewellery and watches adorned with rubies, emeralds and other precious stones.
"The Guinness Book of Records will register this achievement," a company statement said..
The jewellery, insured for an undisclosed sum, will hang on the tree for only a few hours.
Geneva, home to Swiss jewellers and watch-makers, is a world capital for jewellery auctions twice a year.
